import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
img=np.array(Image.open('demo_rgb.png').convert('RGB'));H,W=img.shape[:2]
a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0);b=pd.read_csv('/tmp/msout/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
assert list(a.columns)==list(b.columns) and len(a)==len(b)
p=lambda s:np.array([int(float(v)) for v in str(s).split(',')])
cnt_cv=np.zeros((H,W),int);cnt_pil=np.zeros((H,W),int);ious=[]
vis=img.copy()
for (i,ra),(_,rb) in zip(a.iterrows(),b.iterrows()):
    xs,ys=p(rb.coords_x),p(rb.coords_y)
    assert xs.min()==rb.xmin and xs.max()==rb.xmax and ys.min()==rb.ymin and ys.max()==rb.ymax
    assert not (len(set(zip(xs,ys)))==4 and len(set(xs))==2 and len(set(ys))==2), i
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32)],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=8); assert n==2,(i,n)
    cnt_cv+=m
    im=Image.new('L',(W,H),0);ImageDraw.Draw(im).polygon(list(zip(xs.tolist(),ys.tolist())),fill=1,outline=1);cnt_pil+=np.array(im)
    mo=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8);cv2.fillPoly(mo,[np.stack([p(ra.coords_x),p(ra.coords_y)],1).astype(np.int32)],1)
    ious.append((ra.type,(m&mo).sum()/(m|mo).sum(), m.sum()))
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32)],True,(0,255,0),1)
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([p(ra.coords_x),p(ra.coords_y)],1).astype(np.int32)],True,(255,0,0),1)
print('max overlap cv2',cnt_cv.max(),'PIL',cnt_pil.max())
d=pd.DataFrame(ious,columns=['type','iou','area']);print(d.groupby('type').iou.describe());print('min area',d.area.min())
Image.fromarray(vis).resize((W*2,H*2),Image.NEAREST).save('/tmp/msout/vis.png')
